scope: Milestone 2D.3 candidate ObserverPreset record for ScientificProfileV1, built from public reproducible sources and cross-checked against the owner-supplied campus point

candidatePreset.siteIdentity: Faculty of Computing, UMPSA Pekan Campus, Pahang, Malaysia
candidatePreset.referencePointDescription: The OpenStreetMap point feature 'FK Fakulti Komputeran UMPSA' (node 12825444378, version 3). It is a contributor-mapped point for the Faculty, not a surveyed monument, and not the campus centroid.

referenceSystem.basis: OpenStreetMap documents node latitude/longitude in WGS 84 (https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Node, retrieved 2026-11-01)

coordinateReferenceEpoch.basis: Plate motion of order centimetres per year is orders of magnitude below the derived horizontal bound; the reviewer decides whether that suffices

input.source: Open-Meteo elevation API, Copernicus DEM 2021 release GLO-90 (90 m); a surface model that can include buildings and canopy

heightConversion.model: EGM2008 geoid undulation from GeographicLib GeoidEval 2.5.2
heightConversion.uncertainty: UNKNOWN_UNBOUNDED for the Faculty point; the DEM product states < 4 m absolute vertical accuracy (LE90) for terrain, which does not bound a surface-model cell over buildings

horizontal.meaning: Maximum distance from the reference point to any point of the OpenStreetMap campus polygon (way 1147355347, version 3). It bounds the reference-point error if the Faculty lies inside that polygon, as official UMPSA material states the Faculty is at the Pekan campus.
horizontal.method: Farthest polygon vertex by spherical haversine on the IUGG mean radius
horizontal.confidence: Conditional bound, not a statistical interval

provenance.referencePoint: OpenStreetMap API 0.6 node 12825444378 version 3, changeset 181077159, timestamp 2026-04-09T04:11:31Z
provenance.siteExtent: OpenStreetMap API 0.6 way 1147355347 version 3, timestamp 2024-09-26T08:56:55Z, 33 vertices, closed ring

licences.copernicusDem: Free licence; attribution to the Copernicus programme and DOI citation requested by Open-Meteo
licences.openMeteoApi: Free API used for one noncommercial evidence request; licence page not retrievable on 2026-11-01
licences.geographicLib: Public calculation service; the undulation is a model output

ownerSuppliedCampusPoint.label: Kampus Pekan (Main/Pekan Campus)
ownerSuppliedCampusPoint.role: Independent corroboration that the reference point and the campus polygon identify the UMPSA Pekan campus; not used as the Faculty point

sensitivity.note: Stars are at infinite distance in the geometric route, so the observer position enters only through the local horizon frame and diurnal aberration
